test_keep_alive_argument: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on method arguments to verify child objects stay alive with parent
test_keep_alive_return_value: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on return values to verify returned child objects stay alive with parent
test_alive_gc: test garbage collection of circular references with keep_alive policy on ParentGC objects
test_keep_alive_constructor: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on constructors to verify child argument stays alive with constructed parent
test_call_guard: test pybind11 call_guard policies including GIL held and released states for guarded and unguarded calls
